core_identity.statement: The Observance is a cross-media ARG; Minecraft is one evidence surface rather than the universal puzzle container.
core_identity.lore_requirement: Evidence must be consequential, spooky, uncanny, human, and connected to the central mystery; administrative records may support texture or one layer but may not dominate the investigation grammar.

minecraft_geometry_guard.spatial_environmental_evidence_role: atmosphere, corroboration, optional inference, robust landmark, or one layer of a cross-media deduction
minecraft_geometry_guard.brittleness_rule: A mandatory conclusion may not depend on fragile generated placement of a long exact route, material sequence, or coordinate-perfect decorative simulation.

examples: an NPC line combines with a community post
a found-footage frame recontextualizes a Minecraft artifact
a filename or image detail combines with an earlier book passage
separate clues discovered out of order combine into one exact conclusion

approved_reference_pattern.name: Mara library cipher
approved_reference_pattern.reuse_rule: This establishes fairness and grounding, not a template to repeat across arcs. Other mechanisms must differ in evidentiary job and player operation.

mechanism_example_boundary.rule: The following examples do not define puzzle types. Author generic evidence, state, exact-answer, content, and event primitives, then invent case-specific operations from revelation and character.

non_exhaustive_mechanism_examples: transcript timestamps indexing words spoken at matching found-footage moments
community usernames or post dates aligned with book acrostics or archive order
image crop or contact-sheet coordinates arranged by an in-world sequence
audio spectrogram, Morse, DTMF, or reversed room tone with fair corroboration and accessibility equivalents
file metadata, revision history, filenames, EXIF, checksums, or corrupted manifests used for provenance
substitution alphabets derived from an established NPC habit, emblem, hymn, roster, or recurring typographical error
layered redaction where separate copies expose different portions
route or map overlays performed on supplied images or files rather than fragile Minecraft geometry
book cipher variants using page-line-word, shelf-spine-letter, catalog number, marginal marks, or deliberate mis-shelving
video-frame callbacks reinterpreted after an NPC conversation
conflicting witness accounts whose shared omissions or identical phrasing expose coordination
website or community content changing after an in-world event with catch-up and any-subset recovery
mechanisms not anticipated by any current list, invented from a case's human and emotional reversal

arc_grammar_diversity.grammar: construction-phase and route archaeology across robust cross-media evidence

required_static_checks: every mandatory conclusion declares at least two materially distinct evidence roles or a documented Phase-2 exception
every cipher declares its discoverable key, derivation, operation, answer, corroboration, and accessibility equivalent
every cross-media dependency declares any-subset, out-of-order, replay, catch-up, and outage behavior
no mandatory answer depends on observed-source interaction receipts
no mandatory Minecraft predicate depends on fragile bespoke decorative geometry
each arc preserves its primary grammar and does not reuse a mechanism without a distinct evidentiary job
unavailable media, hosting, community, and social dependencies remain explicit integration gates
mechanism examples remain non-exhaustive and runtime authoring uses generic composable evidence, state, exact-answer, content, and event primitives
Copperline preserves C01's exact belief, majority human texture, immutable provenance, accessibility, and offline-versus-hosted receipt honesty
